__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="hardmode-zuk-experienced-necromancy" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Hardmode Zuk (Experienced - Necromancy)</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/zURz0KcXrt.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction-and-preface"><ins><nowiki>Introduction and preface</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is an </nowiki><strong><nowiki>advanced guide</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#tzkal-zuk-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The rotations used are examples and can be adapted depending on Adrenaline, Residual Soul stacks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Necrosis Stacks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. The lures generally require moving depending on which monsters are blocked prior to using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Players should try to follow this guide as best as possible. If you find that you are slower at moving between luring positions then you should try to always be hitting an enemy while running</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>You should upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1" alt="commandghost" title="commandghost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at all times for a reduction in damage taken, healing and increased damage dealt</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809118283976814.png?v=1" alt="greaterboneshield" title="greaterboneshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179716261681307728.png?v=1" alt="zemouregalsnexus" title="zemouregalsnexus" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be used as defensives will be vital during the encounter, such as to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on challenge wave 15 and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the conduit phase</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643148943856762890.png?v=1" alt="mahj" title="mahj" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505652865695767.png?v=1" alt="invigaura" title="invigaura" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are viable alternatives, however, they are less consistent. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1" alt="equilibriumaura" title="equilibriumaura" kind="icon" /><nowiki> offers consistency, cheap upkeep cost, longer duration, more </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage, and more </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1" alt="commandghost" title="commandghost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> healing</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=DBJShaNHiFWgvpriGLPM <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="preset-notes"><nowiki>Preset Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1" alt="kwuarmsticks" title="kwuarmsticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> used at the bank
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FDBJShaNHiFWgvpriGLPM.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142416978112417812.png?v=1" alt="firstnecrohandwrap" title="firstnecrohandwrap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1232124265826877574.png?v=1" alt="zorgothsring" title="zorgothsring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should only be worn when summoning conjures and when fighting Zuk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1" alt="tzkalzuk" title="tzkalzuk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as he isn't poisonable nor does the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975012160759550042.png?v=1" alt="tokkulzo" title="tokkulzo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff work on him</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Mobile </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk is a must have on gear</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, use Shadow's Grace </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/895999229737185280.png?v=1" alt="shadowsgrace" title="shadowsgrace" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Mage, Ranged or Melee Obsidian Helm </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1100353893063462912.png?v=1" alt="obsidianmagehelm" title="obsidianmagehelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1100353910130102312.png?v=1" alt="obsidianrangerhelm" title="obsidianrangerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1100353943277686924.png?v=1" alt="obsidianwarriorhelm" title="obsidianwarriorhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used for damage reduction. Although it is offstyle, it can be useful for the damage reduction (especially if charged in the Fight Cauldron beforehand). This guide assumes that a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> familiar is used, reducing the need for an offstyle obsidian helm</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> familiar may be used, however, the usefulness of it is limited throughout the majority of the encounter and requires micro-management with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1" alt="ripperscroll" title="ripperscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> use and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933299003121078332.png?v=1" alt="callfollower" title="callfollower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as it is prone to getting stuck behind obstacles</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use the panel icons (1,2,3,4,5,6...) to navigate between each wave. Challenge waves are not included.</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-4-igneous-wave"><nowiki>Wave 4 (Igneous wave)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>General pointers</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To minimise time spent on Igneous waves you should aim to do 2-3 basics and have </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> finish off the igneous mobs. Move towards </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/931175752651653121.png?v=1" alt="tzkalzuk" title="tzkalzuk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while attacking the Igneous Hur (Meleer).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Specific rotations</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Ideally conjures are summoned or extended prior to the igneous mobs spawning, however, if necessary then either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1" alt="lifetransfer" title="lifetransfer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as needed. Similarly, having </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cast before the wave spawns is ideal.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Ideally conjures are summoned or extended prior to the igneous mobs spawning, however, if necessary then either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1" alt="lifetransfer" title="lifetransfer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed. Similarly, having </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cast before the wave spawns is ideal.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<h3 id="wave-14-igneous-wave"><nowiki>Wave 14 (Igneous wave)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Specific rotations</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Ideally conjures are summoned or extended prior to the igneous mobs spawning, however, if necessary then either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1" alt="lifetransfer" title="lifetransfer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed. Similarly, having </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cast before the wave spawns is ideal.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Igneous Mej: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> towards Igneous Xil + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<h3 id="conduits"><nowiki>Conduits</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This assumes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1" alt="livingdeath" title="livingdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> has ran out by the time you get conduits. If this isn't the case you can use an extra </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before living death ends on the conduit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
